provenance.excluded_rows: every (repo, label) candidate the same fetch produced, kept or not; a row's kept field and exclude_reason record why it does or does not count toward worst_seen. below_7b_floor and calibration_out_of_range rows let the monotonicity claim behind the 7B floor be checked from this file instead of taken on faith.
provenance.filter: kept repos whose parameter count checks out against an F16/BF16 sibling or Q8_0/Q6_K published size within 10% of nominal, params >= 7000000000, one row per (repo, label)
provenance.regeneration: one-time snapshot, no checked-in generator. The repo list traces back to a live HuggingFace search (?search=...), so re-running it returns a different repo set, not a reproduction of this one. To refresh: GET https://huggingface.co/api/models/{repo}?blobs=true for each repo of interest, sum sibling .gguf sizes per label with lilbee.catalog.refs.quant_label, divide by gguf.total, and apply the filter above.
provenance.source: HuggingFace API model listing, ?blobs=true, metadata only
